items.title: Duolingo (DUOL) Stock Fair Value Rises After Analysts Lift Targets On User Growth
items.summary: Duolingo’s updated fair value estimate has moved from US$142.85 to US$153.93, which marks a fresh reference point for how some analysts frame the stock. Recent Street research links this change to stronger daily active user data and product updates after Q3, while still questioning how quickly that engagement may show up in subscriptions and bookings. items.title: Walmart Is Up 24% in a Year. Truist Sees Another 6%
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTruist raised its Walmart price target to $134 from $114 after the third-quarter report and kept its Buy rating. That’s 6% above today’s price.

items.title: A $1,500,000 Portfolio in HP, Truist and PepsiCo Pays $65,144 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $1,500,000 portfolio split evenly across HP, Truist Financial and PepsiCo pays about $65,100 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $5,430 a month. HP’s dividend looks the safest of the three, taking 28% of free cash flow over the trailing twelve months.
